facts.raw_span: A 78-year-old female noticed a pronounced flexion of her head and neck three months before her initial hospital visit
with subsequent deterioration of symptoms
Medical history includes hypertension and dementia
with no recent changes in daily medication
The patient complained of neck pain
difficulty with forward gaze
and gait disturbance
No dysphagia was present
The patient denied any neurological deficit such as motor weakness or loss of sensation in bilateral upper and lower extremities
No neuromuscular or autoimmune diseases were noted
